description: This Java class 'AclModifiedStrategy' handles 'AclModified' events in the Eclipse Ditto project, applying changes to a 'ThingBuilder' based on ACL modifications.

classes.name: AclModifiedStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that processes ACL modification events to update a 'ThingBuilder' with new permissions.

methods.name: applyEvent(AclModified event, ThingBuilder.FromCopy thingBuilder)
methods.description: Applies the ACL modification event to the provided ThingBuilder, removing all existing permissions and setting new permissions from the event.
